sloka: सुदीर्घस्य तु कालस्य राघवो ऽयं महाद्युति: ।विश्वामित्रेण सहितो यज्ञं द्रष्टुं समागत: ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा राम: सत्यपराक्रम: ॥ २.११८.४४॥
transliteration: sudīrghasya tu kālasya rāghavo 'yaṁ mahādyuti: ।viśvāmitreṇa sahito yajñaṁ draṣṭuṁ samāgata: ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāma: satyaparākrama: ॥ 2.118.44॥

translations.english: After a long time, resplendent Rama whose prowess was truth, arrived along with his brother Lakshman and sage Viswamitra in order to witness the sacrifice.
